verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a serverless and data platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents state persistence (Workflows, Durable Objects, agent storage), caching and observability, but nothing about configurable retention periods, log retention settings, or data deletion controls. Persistence features are adjacent and earn no credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
